+"""Service layer implementing business logic."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from typing import Any
+
+from agentic_odi_core.models import (
+    BusinessValue,
+    CustomerOutcome,
+    CustomerValue,
+    Evidence,
+    EvidenceItemType,
+    Job,
+    Outcome,
+    Step,
+    compute_opportunity_score,
+)
+from agentic_odi_core.repository import Repository
+
+
+class JobNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, job_id: str) -> None:
+        self.job_id = job_id
+        super().__init__(job_id)
+
+
+class StepNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, step_id: str) -> None:
+        self.step_id = step_id
+        super().__init__(step_id)
+
+
+class OutcomeNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, outcome_id: str) -> None:
+        self.outcome_id = outcome_id
+        super().__init__(outcome_id)
+
+
+class CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, outcome_id: str) -> None:
+        self.outcome_id = outcome_id
+        super().__init__(outcome_id)
+
+
+class EvidenceNotFoundError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, evidence_id: str) -> None:
+        self.evidence_id = evidence_id
+        super().__init__(evidence_id)
+
+
+class ValueOutOfRangeError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def _first_line(text: str) -> str:
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        stripped = line.strip()
+        if stripped:
+            return stripped
+    return ""
+
+
+class ODIService:
+    def __init__(self, repo: Repository) -> None:
+        self.repo = repo
+
+    def add_job(self, name: str, description: str | None = None) -> Job:
+        job = Job(name=name, description=description)
+        return self.repo.add_job(job)
+
+    def get_jobs(self) -> list[Job]:
+        return self.repo.list_jobs()
+
+    def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> Job | None:
+        return self.repo.get_job(job_id)
+
+    def get_step(self, step_id: str) -> Step | None:
+        return self.repo.get_step(step_id)
+
+    def get_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> Outcome | None:
+        return self.repo.get_outcome(outcome_id)
+
+    def update_job(self, job_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> Job:
+        res = self.repo.update_job(job_id, updates)
+        if not res:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+        return res
+
+    def delete_job(self, job_id: str) -> None:
+        ok = self.repo.delete_job(job_id)
+        if not ok:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+
+    def update_step(self, step_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> Step:
+        res = self.repo.update_step(step_id, updates)
+        if not res:
+            raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+        return res
+
+    def delete_step(self, step_id: str) -> None:
+        ok = self.repo.delete_step(step_id)
+        if not ok:
+            raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+
+    def update_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> Outcome:
+        existing = self.repo.get_outcome(outcome_id)
+        if existing is None:
+            raise OutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+        importance = updates.get("importance", existing.importance)
+        satisfaction = updates.get("satisfaction", existing.satisfaction)
+        if importance is not None and not (1.0 <= importance <= 10.0):
+            raise ValueOutOfRangeError()
+        if satisfaction is not None and not (1.0 <= satisfaction <= 10.0):
+            raise ValueOutOfRangeError()
+        if importance is not None and satisfaction is not None:
+            updates = dict(updates)
+            updates["opportunity_score"] = compute_opportunity_score(importance, satisfaction)
+        else:
+            updates = dict(updates)
+            updates["opportunity_score"] = None
+        res = self.repo.update_outcome(outcome_id, updates)
+        if not res:
+            raise OutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+        return res
+
+    def delete_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> None:
+        ok = self.repo.delete_outcome(outcome_id)
+        if not ok:
+            raise OutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+
+    def add_step(self, job_id: str, name: str, order: int) -> Step:
+        if self.repo.get_job(job_id) is None:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+        step = Step(id=str(uuid.uuid4()), job_id=job_id, name=name, order=order)
+        return self.repo.add_step(step)
+
+    def get_job_map(self, job_id: str) -> list[Step]:
+        steps = self.repo.get_steps_for_job(job_id)
+        return sorted(steps, key=lambda s: s.order)
+
+    def add_outcome(
+        self,
+        job_id: str,
+        statement: str,
+        importance: float | None = None,
+        satisfaction: float | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> Outcome:
+        if self.repo.get_job(job_id) is None:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+        if step_id is not None and self.repo.get_step(step_id) is None:
+            raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+        if importance is not None and not (1.0 <= importance <= 10.0):
+            raise ValueOutOfRangeError()
+        if satisfaction is not None and not (1.0 <= satisfaction <= 10.0):
+            raise ValueOutOfRangeError()
+        opportunity_score = None
+        if importance is not None and satisfaction is not None:
+            opportunity_score = compute_opportunity_score(importance, satisfaction)
+        outcome = Outcome(
+            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            job_id=job_id,
+            step_id=step_id,
+            statement=statement,
+            importance=importance,
+            satisfaction=satisfaction,
+            opportunity_score=opportunity_score,
+        )
+        return self.repo.add_outcome(outcome)
+
+    def get_outcomes(self, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> list[Outcome]:
+        return self.repo.get_outcomes(job_id, step_id)
+
+    def add_customer_outcome(
+        self,
+        job_id: str,
+        customer_value: CustomerValue | dict[str, Any],
+        business_value: BusinessValue | dict[str, Any],
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> CustomerOutcome:
+        if self.repo.get_job(job_id) is None:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(job_id)
+        if step_id is not None and self.repo.get_step(step_id) is None:
+            raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+        if isinstance(customer_value, dict):
+            cv = CustomerValue.model_validate(customer_value)
+        else:
+            cv = customer_value
+        if isinstance(business_value, dict):
+            bv = BusinessValue.model_validate(business_value)
+        else:
+            bv = business_value
+        co = CustomerOutcome(
+            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            job_id=job_id,
+            step_id=step_id,
+            customer_value=cv,
+            business_value=bv,
+        )
+        return self.repo.add_customer_outcome(co)
+
+    def get_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> CustomerOutcome:
+        co = self.repo.get_customer_outcome(outcome_id)
+        if not co:
+            raise CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+        return co
+
+    def list_customer_outcomes(self, job_id: str | None = None) -> list[CustomerOutcome]:
+        return self.repo.list_customer_outcomes(job_id)
+
+    def update_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> CustomerOutcome:
+        res = self.repo.update_customer_outcome(outcome_id, updates)
+        if not res:
+            raise CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+        return res
+
+    def delete_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> None:
+        ok = self.repo.delete_customer_outcome(outcome_id)
+        if not ok:
+            raise CustomerOutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+
+    def add_evidence(
+        self,
+        source_name: str,
+        source_kind: str,
+        name: str,
+        content: str,
+        item_type: EvidenceItemType = "manual",
+        raw: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+        outcome_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> Evidence:
+        resolved_job_id = job_id
+        if step_id is not None:
+            step = self.repo.get_step(step_id)
+            if step is None:
+                raise StepNotFoundError(step_id)
+            if resolved_job_id is None:
+                resolved_job_id = step.job_id
+            elif step.job_id != resolved_job_id:
+                raise ValueError("step_id does not belong to job_id")
+        if outcome_id is not None:
+            outcome = self.repo.get_outcome(outcome_id)
+            if outcome is None:
+                raise OutcomeNotFoundError(outcome_id)
+            if resolved_job_id is None:
+                resolved_job_id = outcome.job_id
+            elif outcome.job_id != resolved_job_id:
+                raise ValueError("outcome_id does not belong to job_id")
+            if step_id is not None and outcome.step_id not in (None, step_id):
+                raise ValueError("outcome_id does not belong to step_id")
+        if resolved_job_id is not None and self.repo.get_job(resolved_job_id) is None:
+            raise JobNotFoundError(resolved_job_id)
+        evidence = Evidence(
+            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+            source_name=source_name,
+            source_kind=source_kind,
+            item_type=item_type,
+            name=name,
+            content=content,
+            raw=raw or {},
+            job_id=resolved_job_id,
+            step_id=step_id,
+            outcome_id=outcome_id,
+        )
+        return self.repo.add_evidence(evidence)
+
+    def get_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> Evidence | None:
+        return self.repo.get_evidence(evidence_id)
+
+    def list_evidence(
+        self,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+        outcome_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> list[Evidence]:
+        return self.repo.list_evidence(job_id=job_id, step_id=step_id, outcome_id=outcome_id)
+
+    def delete_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> None:
+        if not self.repo.delete_evidence(evidence_id):
+            raise EvidenceNotFoundError(evidence_id)
+
+    def promote_evidence(
+        self,
+        evidence_id: str,
+        target: str,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        statement: str | None = None,
+        name: str | None = None,
+        importance: float | None = None,
+        satisfaction: float | None = None,
+    ) -> Job | Outcome:
+        evidence = self.repo.get_evidence(evidence_id)
+        if evidence is None:
+            raise EvidenceNotFoundError(evidence_id)
+        if target == "job":
+            label = (
+                (name or evidence.name).strip() or _first_line(evidence.content) or "Imported job"
+            )
+            return self.add_job(label, description=evidence.content or None)
+        if target == "outcome":
+            target_job_id = job_id or evidence.job_id
+            if target_job_id is None:
+                raise ValueError("job_id is required to promote evidence to an outcome")
+            text = (
+                statement
+                or evidence.name.strip()
+                or _first_line(evidence.content)
+                or "Untitled outcome"
+            )
+            return self.add_outcome(
+                target_job_id,
+                text,
+                importance=importance,
+                satisfaction=satisfaction,
+                step_id=evidence.step_id,
+            )
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown promotion target: {target}")
+
+    def compute_opportunity(self, importance: float, satisfaction: float) -> float:
+        return compute_opportunity_score(importance, satisfaction)

--- packages/core/src/agentic_odi_core/sqlite_repository.py	
+++ packages/core/src/agentic_odi_core/sqlite_repository.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,402 @@
+"""SQLite-backed repository using append-only IntentStore for events/audit."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import threading
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError
+
+from agentic_odi_core.events import DEFAULT_DEVICE, DEFAULT_WORKSPACE, Event
+from agentic_odi_core.intent_store import IntentStore
+from agentic_odi_core.models import CustomerOutcome, Evidence, Job, Outcome, Step
+from agentic_odi_core.repository import Repository
+
+
+class SQLiteRepository(Repository):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        db_path: str | None = None,
+        workspace_id: str | None = None,
+        device_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if db_path is None:
+            db_path = os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_DB", os.path.expanduser("~/.agentic-odi/odi.db"))
+        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(db_path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
+        self._lock = threading.RLock()
+        self._workspace_id = workspace_id or os.environ.get(
+            "AGENTIC_ODI_WORKSPACE", DEFAULT_WORKSPACE
+        )
+        self._device_id = device_id or os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_DEVICE_ID", DEFAULT_DEVICE)
+        self.store = IntentStore(db_path, check_same_thread=False)
+        self._last_event_id = 0
+        self._load_snapshot()
+
+    def _load_snapshot(self) -> None:
+        self.jobs: dict[str, Job] = {}
+        self.steps: dict[str, Step] = {}
+        self.outcomes: dict[str, Outcome] = {}
+        self.customer_outcomes: dict[str, CustomerOutcome] = {}
+        self.evidence: dict[str, Evidence] = {}
+        self._last_event_id = 0
+        for ev in self.store.get_stream(workspace_id=self._workspace_id, replay_order=True):
+            self._apply_event(ev)
+
+    def _sync(self) -> None:
+        for ev in self.store.get_stream(workspace_id=self._workspace_id):
+            if ev["id"] > self._last_event_id:
+                self._apply_event(ev)
+
+    def _apply_event(self, ev: Event) -> None:
+        et = ev["type"]
+        p = ev["payload"]
+        if et == "JOB_CREATED":
+            self.jobs[p["id"]] = Job.model_validate(p)
+        elif et == "STEP_CREATED":
+            self.steps[p["id"]] = Step.model_validate(p)
+        elif et == "OUTCOME_CREATED":
+            self.outcomes[p["id"]] = Outcome.model_validate(p)
+        elif et == "CUSTOMER_OUTCOME_CREATED":
+            self.customer_outcomes[p["id"]] = CustomerOutcome.model_validate(p)
+        elif et == "EVIDENCE_CREATED":
+            self.evidence[p["id"]] = Evidence.model_validate(p)
+        elif et == "JOB_UPDATED":
+            self._merge_updates(self.jobs, p, Job)
+        elif et == "STEP_UPDATED":
+            self._merge_updates(self.steps, p, Step)
+        elif et == "OUTCOME_UPDATED":
+            self._merge_updates(self.outcomes, p, Outcome)
+        elif et == "CUSTOMER_OUTCOME_UPDATED":
+            self._merge_updates(self.customer_outcomes, p, CustomerOutcome)
+        elif et == "JOB_DELETED":
+            job_id = p["id"]
+            self.jobs.pop(job_id, None)
+            for key in [k for k, v in self.steps.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+                del self.steps[key]
+            for key in [k for k, v in self.outcomes.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+                del self.outcomes[key]
+            for key in [k for k, v in self.customer_outcomes.items() if v.job_id == job_id]:
+                del self.customer_outcomes[key]
+            for key in [
+                k
+                for k, v in self.evidence.items()
+                if v.job_id == job_id
+                or (v.step_id is not None and v.step_id not in self.steps)
+                or (v.outcome_id is not None and v.outcome_id not in self.outcomes)
+            ]:
+                del self.evidence[key]
+        elif et == "STEP_DELETED":
+            step_id = p["id"]
+            self.steps.pop(step_id, None)
+            for key in [k for k, v in self.outcomes.items() if v.step_id == step_id]:
+                del self.outcomes[key]
+            for key in [k for k, v in self.customer_outcomes.items() if v.step_id == step_id]:
+                del self.customer_outcomes[key]
+            for key in [
+                k
+                for k, v in self.evidence.items()
+                if v.step_id == step_id
+                or (v.outcome_id is not None and v.outcome_id not in self.outcomes)
+            ]:
+                del self.evidence[key]
+        elif et == "OUTCOME_DELETED":
+            outcome_id = p["id"]
+            self.outcomes.pop(outcome_id, None)
+            for key in [k for k, v in self.evidence.items() if v.outcome_id == outcome_id]:
+                del self.evidence[key]
+        elif et == "EVIDENCE_DELETED":
+            self.evidence.pop(p["id"], None)
+        elif et == "CUSTOMER_OUTCOME_DELETED":
+            self.customer_outcomes.pop(p["id"], None)
+        self._last_event_id = max(self._last_event_id, ev["id"])
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _merge_updates(entities: dict[str, Any], p: dict, model: type[BaseModel]) -> None:
+        entity = entities.get(p["id"])
+        if entity is None:
+            return
+        current = entity.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        current.update(p.get("updates", {}))
+        try:
+            entities[p["id"]] = model.model_validate(current)
+        except ValidationError:
+            pass
+
+    def add_job(self, job: Job) -> Job:
+        with self._lock:
+            self.store.append(
+                "JOB_CREATED",
+                job.model_dump(),
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return job
+
+    def list_jobs(self) -> list[Job]:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            return list(self.jobs.values())
+
+    def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> Job | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            return self.jobs.get(job_id)
+
+    def update_job(self, job_id: str, updates: dict) -> Job | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            job = self.jobs.get(job_id)
+            if not job:
+                return None
+            current = job.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+            current.update(updates)
+            new_job = job.model_validate(current)
+            self.store.append(
+                "JOB_UPDATED",
+                {"id": job_id, "updates": updates},
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return new_job
+
+    def delete_job(self, job_id: str) -> bool:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            if job_id not in self.jobs:
+                return False
+            self.store.append(
+                "JOB_DELETED",
+                {"id": job_id},
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return True
+
+    def add_step(self, step: Step) -> Step:
+        with self._lock:
+            self.store.append(
+                "STEP_CREATED",
+                step.model_dump(),
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return step
+
+    def get_step(self, step_id: str) -> Step | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            return self.steps.get(step_id)
+
+    def get_steps_for_job(self, job_id: str) -> list[Step]:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            return [s for s in self.steps.values() if s.job_id == job_id]
+
+    def update_step(self, step_id: str, updates: dict) -> Step | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            step = self.steps.get(step_id)
+            if not step:
+                return None
+            current = step.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+            current.update(updates)
+            new_step = step.model_validate(current)
+            self.store.append(
+                "STEP_UPDATED",
+                {"id": step_id, "updates": updates},
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return new_step
+
+    def delete_step(self, step_id: str) -> bool:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            if step_id not in self.steps:
+                return False
+            self.store.append(
+                "STEP_DELETED",
+                {"id": step_id},
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return True
+
+    def add_outcome(self, outcome: Outcome) -> Outcome:
+        with self._lock:
+            self.store.append(
+                "OUTCOME_CREATED",
+                outcome.model_dump(),
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return outcome
+
+    def get_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> Outcome | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            return self.outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+
+    def get_outcomes(self, job_id: str, step_id: str | None = None) -> list[Outcome]:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            outs = [o for o in self.outcomes.values() if o.job_id == job_id]
+            if step_id is not None:
+                outs = [o for o in outs if o.step_id == step_id]
+            return outs
+
+    def update_outcome(self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict) -> Outcome | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            outcome = self.outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+            if not outcome:
+                return None
+            current = outcome.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+            current.update(updates)
+            new_outcome = outcome.model_validate(current)
+            self.store.append(
+                "OUTCOME_UPDATED",
+                {"id": outcome_id, "updates": updates},
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return new_outcome
+
+    def delete_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            if outcome_id not in self.outcomes:
+                return False
+            self.store.append(
+                "OUTCOME_DELETED",
+                {"id": outcome_id},
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return True
+
+    def add_customer_outcome(self, co: CustomerOutcome) -> CustomerOutcome:
+        with self._lock:
+            self.store.append(
+                "CUSTOMER_OUTCOME_CREATED",
+                co.model_dump(),
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return co
+
+    def get_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> CustomerOutcome | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            return self.customer_outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+
+    def list_customer_outcomes(self, job_id: str | None = None) -> list[CustomerOutcome]:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            if job_id is None:
+                return list(self.customer_outcomes.values())
+            return [co for co in self.customer_outcomes.values() if co.job_id == job_id]
+
+    def update_customer_outcome(
+        self, outcome_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]
+    ) -> CustomerOutcome | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            co = self.customer_outcomes.get(outcome_id)
+            if not co:
+                return None
+            current = co.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+            current.update(updates)
+            try:
+                new_co = co.model_validate(current)
+            except ValidationError:
+                return None
+            self.store.append(
+                "CUSTOMER_OUTCOME_UPDATED",
+                {"id": outcome_id, "updates": updates},
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return new_co
+
+    def add_evidence(self, evidence: Evidence) -> Evidence:
+        with self._lock:
+            self.store.append(
+                "EVIDENCE_CREATED",
+                evidence.model_dump(),
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return evidence
+
+    def get_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> Evidence | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            return self.evidence.get(evidence_id)
+
+    def list_evidence(
+        self,
+        job_id: str | None = None,
+        step_id: str | None = None,
+        outcome_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> list[Evidence]:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            items = list(self.evidence.values())
+            if job_id is not None:
+                items = [item for item in items if item.job_id == job_id]
+            if step_id is not None:
+                items = [item for item in items if item.step_id == step_id]
+            if outcome_id is not None:
+                items = [item for item in items if item.outcome_id == outcome_id]
+            return items
+
+    def delete_evidence(self, evidence_id: str) -> bool:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            if evidence_id not in self.evidence:
+                return False
+            self.store.append(
+                "EVIDENCE_DELETED",
+                {"id": evidence_id},
+                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                device_id=self._device_id,
+            )
+            self._sync()
+            return True
+
+    def delete_customer_outcome(self, outcome_id: str) -> bool:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._sync()
+            if outcome_id in self.customer_outcomes:
+                self.store.append(
+                    "CUSTOMER_OUTCOME_DELETED",
+                    {"id": outcome_id},
+                    workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
+                    device_id=self._device_id,
+                )
+                self._sync()
+                return True
+            return False
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self.store.clear()
+            self._load_snapshot()
+
+    def reload(self) -> None:
+        """Re‑load the local snapshot from the event store."""
+        self._load_snapshot()

+"""Tests for the new event-store schema and migration."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlite3
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from agentic_odi_core.intent_store import IntentStore
+
+
+def test_legacy_db_backfill_adds_event_id_and_spaces(tmp_path) -> None:
+    """An existing `odi.db` without `event_id` columns must be upgraded."""
+    db = Path(tmp_path) / "odi.db"
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(db)
+    conn.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE events (
+            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+            timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
+            event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
+            payload TEXT NOT NULL
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    conn.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO events (timestamp, event_type, payload) VALUES ('2026-01-01T00:00:00', 'JOB_CREATED', '{\"id\": \"j1\"}')"
+    )
+    conn.commit()
+    conn.close()
+
+    store = IntentStore(str(db))
+    events = store.get_stream()
+    # The migration must have added event_id, workspace_id, device_id columns,
+    # backfilled them, and the row must contain them.
+    assert len(events) == 1
+    ev = events[0]
+    assert ev["event_id"]
+    assert ev["workspace_id"] == "local"
+    assert ev["device_id"] == "local"
+    assert ev["server_seq"] is None
+    store.close()
+
+
+def test_new_db_has_all_columns(tmp_path) -> None:
+    """A freshly created DB must contain all new event columns."""
+    db = Path(tmp_path) / "odi.db"
+    store = IntentStore(str(db))
+    events = store.get_stream()
+    assert len(events) == 0
+    # Verify schema contains all new columns via PRAGMA introspection.
+    # (the constructor runs _migrate_events_table and adds columns.)
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db))
+    cols = {row[1] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(events)").fetchall()}
+    assert "event_id" in cols, f"Missing event_id column, got: {cols}"
+    assert "workspace_id" in cols
+    assert "device_id" in cols
+    assert "server_seq" in cols
+    conn.close()
+    store.close()

+"""Tests for the append-only Intent Store."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from agentic_odi_core.intent_store import IntentStore
+
+
+def test_append_and_get_stream_return_events_in_order(tmp_path) -> None:
+    store = IntentStore(str(tmp_path / "events.db"))
+    try:
+        store.append("JOB_CREATED", {"id": "job-1"})
+        store.append("STEP_CREATED", {"id": "step-1", "job_id": "job-1"})
+
+        stream = store.get_stream()
+    finally:
+        store.close()
+
+    assert [event["type"] for event in stream] == ["JOB_CREATED", "STEP_CREATED"]
+    assert [event["payload"] for event in stream] == [
+        {"id": "job-1"},
+        {"id": "step-1", "job_id": "job-1"},
+    ]
+    assert [event["id"] for event in stream] == [1, 2]
+    assert all(event["timestamp"] for event in stream)
+
+
+def test_clear_removes_every_event(tmp_path) -> None:
+    store = IntentStore(str(tmp_path / "events.db"))
+    try:
+        store.append("JOB_CREATED", {"id": "job-1"})
+        store.clear()
+        assert store.get_stream() == []
+    finally:
+        store.close()
+
+
+def test_get_stream_treats_blank_payload_as_empty_dict(tmp_path) -> None:
+    store = IntentStore(str(tmp_path / "events.db"))
+    try:
+        store.conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO events (timestamp, event_type, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
+            ("2026-01-01T00:00:00", "LEGACY", ""),
+        )
+        store.conn.commit()
+
+        assert store.get_stream()[0]["payload"] == {}
+    finally:
+        store.close()

+"""
+Local dev launcher for Agentic ODI.
+
+Starts the FastMCP server (``python -m agentic_odi_mcp_server``) and the Living
+Studio sidecar (``uvicorn agentic_odi_studio_api.app:create_app --factory``)
+concurrently, then prints the MCP and Studio URLs. Shutting down this script
+(Ctrl+C) terminates both processes.
+
+Usage:
+    uv run python scripts/dev.py
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import signal
+import socket
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 - launches only fixed child commands (see B603 notes)
+import sys
+import time
+
+MCP_PORT = 8000
+STUDIO_PORT = 8100
+
+REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+SPA_DIST = os.environ.get(
+    "AGENTIC_ODI_STUDIO_DIST", os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "apps", "studio", "dist")
+)
+SPA_BUILD_HINT = (
+    "Frontend not built — run `npm --prefix apps/studio run build` to serve the Studio UI."
+)
+
+
+def is_port_in_use(port: int) -> bool:
+    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
+        return s.connect_ex(("localhost", port)) == 0
+
+
+def build_commands() -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Return the (mcp_server, sidecar) argv lists, both shell-free and fixed."""
+    mcp_command = [sys.executable, "-m", "agentic_odi_mcp_server"]
+    sidecar_command = [
+        sys.executable,
+        "-m",
+        "uvicorn",
+        "agentic_odi_studio_api.app:create_app",
+        "--factory",
+        "--host",
+        "127.0.0.1",
+        "--port",
+        str(STUDIO_PORT),
+    ]
+    return mcp_command, sidecar_command
+
+
+def start_server() -> subprocess.Popen:
+    if is_port_in_use(MCP_PORT):
+        print(f"Error: Port {MCP_PORT} is already in use.")
+        print("Please stop any process running on this port and try again.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    mcp_command, _ = build_commands()
+    print(f"Starting MCP server on http://localhost:{MCP_PORT}/mcp ...")
+    # Fixed command, no shell, no untrusted input.
+    return subprocess.Popen(mcp_command)  # nosec B603
+
+
+def start_studio() -> subprocess.Popen:
+    if is_port_in_use(STUDIO_PORT):
+        print(f"Warning: Port {STUDIO_PORT} is already in use. The sidecar may fail to start.")
+
+    _, sidecar_command = build_commands()
+    print(f"Starting Living Studio sidecar on http://localhost:{STUDIO_PORT} ...")
+    # Fixed command, no shell, no untrusted input.
+    return subprocess.Popen(sidecar_command)  # nosec B603
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    server = None
+    studio = None
+
+    def shutdown(signum=None, frame=None):
+        print("\nShutting down...")
+        if studio:
+            studio.terminate()
+        if server:
+            server.terminate()
+
+        try:
+            if studio:
+                studio.wait(timeout=5)
+            if server:
+                server.wait(timeout=5)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            if studio:
+                studio.kill()
+            if server:
+                server.kill()
+
+        print("✅ All processes stopped.")
+        sys.exit(0)
+
+    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, shutdown)
+    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, shutdown)
+
+    try:
+        server = start_server()
+        # Give the server a moment to bind its port before the sidecar connects
+        time.sleep(2)
+        studio = start_studio()
+
+        print("\nBoth processes are running.")
+        print(f"MCP Server   -> http://localhost:{MCP_PORT}/mcp")
+        print(f"Living Studio -> http://localhost:{STUDIO_PORT}")
+        if not os.path.isdir(SPA_DIST):
+            print(f"\n⚠️  {SPA_BUILD_HINT}")
+        print("\nPress Ctrl+C to stop both.\n")
+
+        # Wait for either process to exit unexpectedly
+        while True:
+            rc_server = server.poll()
+            rc_studio = studio.poll()
+
+            if rc_server is not None:
+                print(f"\nServer exited unexpectedly (code {rc_server}).")
+                break
+
+            if rc_studio is not None:
+                print(f"\nStudio sidecar exited unexpectedly (code {rc_studio}).")
+                break
+
+            time.sleep(1)
+
+    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
+        print(f"\nError: {e}")
+    finally:
+        shutdown()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Generate and publish end-user "Download & Run" instructions for a GitHub release.
+
+Pure functions:
+    build_instructions_section(tag, repo, artifacts, checksums_text) -> str
+    apply_instructions(body, section) -> str
+
+CLI (``main``): fetches the release body/assets via ``gh``, grabs
+``checksums.txt`` via ``curl``, builds the instructions section, applies it
+idempotently to the release body, and publishes with ``gh release edit``
+(unless ``--dry-run``).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DOWNLOAD_START = "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->"
+DOWNLOAD_END = "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->"
+
+GITHUB_RELEASES = "https://github.com"
+
+
+def _archive_target(name: str) -> str:
+    """Strip the ``odi_<version>_`` prefix and archive suffix to expose ``<os>_<arch>``."""
+    stem = name
+    for suffix in (".tar.gz", ".zip"):
+        if stem.endswith(suffix):
+            stem = stem[: -len(suffix)]
+            break
+    if stem.startswith("odi_"):
+        stem = stem[len("odi_") :]
+    parts = stem.split("_")
+    if len(parts) >= 3:
+        return "_".join(parts[1:])
+    return stem
+
+
+def _platform(target: str) -> str:
+    mapping = {
+        "linux_x86_64": "Linux (x86_64)",
+        "linux_arm64": "Linux (ARM64)",
+        "macos_x86_64": "macOS (Intel)",
+        "macos_arm64": "macOS (Apple Silicon)",
+        "windows_x86_64": "Windows (x86_64)",
+    }
+    return mapping.get(target, target.replace("_", " ").title())
+
+
+def _hash_for(checksums_text: str, name: str) -> str | None:
+    for line in checksums_text.splitlines():
+        line = line.strip()
+        if not line:
+            continue
+        hash_, sep, fname = line.partition("  ")
+        if not sep:
+            hash_, sep, fname = line.partition(" ")
+        fname = fname.lstrip("*").strip()
+        if fname == name:
+            return hash_.strip()
+    return None
+
+
+def build_instructions_section(
+    tag: str, repo: str, artifacts: list[dict], checksums_text: str
+) -> str:
+    version = tag.lstrip("v")
+    dl_base = f"{GITHUB_RELEASES}/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}"
+
+    release_artifacts = [
+        a for a in artifacts if a["name"] not in ("checksums.txt", "install.sh", "install.ps1")
+    ]
+
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    lines.append("## 📦 Download & Run")
+    lines.append("")
+    lines.append(
+        f"Prebuilt binaries for **Agentic ODI {version}** are attached to this release. "
+        "Pick the archive for your platform, verify its SHA-256 against ``checksums.txt``, "
+        "then install with the one-liner below."
+    )
+    lines.append("")
+
+    if release_artifacts:
+        lines.append("| Platform | Archive | Download | SHA-256 |")
+        lines.append("| --- | --- | --- | --- |")
+        for a in sorted(release_artifacts, key=lambda x: x["name"]):
+            name = a["name"]
+            target = _archive_target(name)
+            url = a["browser_download_url"]
+            digest = _hash_for(checksums_text, name) or "—"
+            lines.append(f"| {_platform(target)} | {name} | [download]({url}) | `{digest}` |")
+        lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Verify")
+    lines.append("Download ``checksums.txt`` from this release and verify the archive you picked:")
+    lines.append("")
+    lines.append("```bash")
+    lines.append("curl -fsSL -O checksums.txt")
+    lines.append(f"{dl_base}/checksums.txt")
+    lines.append("sha256sum -c checksums.txt   # or: shasum -a 256 -c checksums.txt")
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Install (one liner)")
+    lines.append("**Linux / macOS**")
+    lines.append("```bash")
+    lines.append(f"curl -fsSL {dl_base}/install.sh | sh")
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("**Windows (PowerShell)**")
+    lines.append("```powershell")
+    lines.append(f"iex (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri {dl_base}/install.ps1 -UseBasicParsing)")
+    lines.append("# shorthand: install.ps1 | iex")
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Install manually")
+    lines.append(
+        "Extract the archive, then add the folder containing the ``odi`` executable to your ``PATH``."
+    )
+    lines.append("")
+    lines.append("```bash")
+    lines.append(f"tar -xzf odi_{version}_<platform>.tar.gz   # or unzip the .zip on Windows")
+    lines.append('export PATH="$PWD:$PATH"')
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Quick start")
+    lines.append("```bash")
+    lines.append("odi --version")
+    lines.append("odi --help")
+    lines.append("odi jobs list")
+    lines.append("```")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append("### Related artifacts")
+    for kind in ("checksums.txt", "install.sh", "install.ps1"):
+        match = next((a for a in artifacts if a["name"] == kind), None)
+        if match:
+            lines.append(f"- [{kind}]({match['browser_download_url']})")
+    lines.append("")
+
+    lines.append(
+        "> macOS may quarantine the downloaded binary "
+        "(``xattr -d com.apple.quarantine odi`` if needed). "
+        'Windows SmartScreen may warn for unsigned binaries; choose "More info → Run anyway" '
+        "if you trust the release."
+    )
+    lines.append("")
+
+    return f"{DOWNLOAD_START}\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n" + DOWNLOAD_END + "\n"
+
+
+def apply_instructions(body: str | None, section: str) -> str:
+    current = body if body is not None else ""
+    start = current.find(DOWNLOAD_START)
+    end = current.find(DOWNLOAD_END)
+    if start != -1 and end != -1 and end > start:
+        head = current[:start].rstrip()
+        tail = current[end + len(DOWNLOAD_END) :].lstrip("\n")
+        if head and tail:
+            return head + "\n\n" + section + "\n" + tail
+        if head:
+            return head + "\n\n" + section + "\n" + tail
+        return section + "\n" + tail
+    current = current.rstrip()
+    if not current:
+        return section
+    return current + "\n\n" + section
+
+
+def _run(cmd: list[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Publish end-user download & run instructions to a GitHub release."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--tag", required=True, help="Release tag, e.g. v0.7.0")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--repo",
+        default=os.environ.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY", ""),
+        help="GitHub repository as owner/name",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--dry-run",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="Print the new body instead of publishing",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    tag = args.tag
+    repo = args.repo
+    if not repo:
+        print("error: --repo or GITHUB_REPOSITORY is required", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    view = _run(["gh", "release", "view", tag, "--repo", repo, "--json", "body"])
+    body = json.loads(view.stdout).get("body", "") or ""
+
+    assets: list[dict] = []
+    try:
+        api = _run(["gh", "api", f"repos/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag}", "--json", "assets"])
+        assets = json.loads(api.stdout).get("assets", [])
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
+        assets = []
+
+    checksums_text = ""
+    try:
+        ck = _run(
+            [
+                "curl",
+                "-fsSL",
+                f"{GITHUB_RELEASES}/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}/checksums.txt",
+            ]
+        )
+        checksums_text = ck.stdout
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
+        checksums_text = ""
+
+    section = build_instructions_section(tag, repo, assets, checksums_text)
+    new_body = apply_instructions(body, section)
+
+    if args.dry_run:
+        print(new_body)
+        return 0
+
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".md", delete=False) as fh:
+        fh.write(new_body)
+        notes_path = fh.name
+    try:
+        _run(["gh", "release", "edit", tag, "--repo", repo, "--notes-file", notes_path])
+    finally:
+        Path(notes_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Keep the live MCP surface in lockstep with the core contract."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from agentic_odi_core.contract import TOOL_SPECS
+from agentic_odi_mcp_server.mcp_server import mcp
+from fastmcp import Client
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_mcp_exposes_exactly_the_contract_tools() -> None:
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        tools = await client.list_tools()
+
+    assert {tool.name for tool in tools} == set(TOOL_SPECS)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_mcp_argument_names_match_the_contract() -> None:
+    async with Client(mcp) as client:
+        tools = {tool.name: tool for tool in await client.list_tools()}
+
+    for name, spec in TOOL_SPECS.items():
+        schema = tools[name].input_schema
+        assert set(schema.get("properties", {})) == set(spec.arguments), name
+        assert set(schema.get("required", [])) == set(spec.required), name

+import socket
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from scripts import dev as run
+from scripts.dev import is_port_in_use
+
+
+def test_is_port_in_use_detects_bound_port():
+    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
+        s.bind(("localhost", 0))
+        s.listen(1)
+        port = s.getsockname()[1]
+
+        assert is_port_in_use(port) is True
+
+
+def test_is_port_in_use_returns_false_for_free_port():
+    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
+        s.bind(("localhost", 0))
+        port = s.getsockname()[1]
+
+    assert is_port_in_use(port) is False
+
+
+def test_ports_are_mcp_and_sidecar():
+    assert run.MCP_PORT == 8000
+    assert run.STUDIO_PORT == 8100
+
+
+def test_build_commands_exposes_mcp_and_sidecar():
+    mcp, sidecar = run.build_commands()
+
+    assert mcp == [sys.executable, "-m", "agentic_odi_mcp_server"]
+    assert "uvicorn" in sidecar
+    assert "agentic_odi_studio_api.app:create_app" in sidecar
+    assert "--factory" in sidecar
+    assert str(run.STUDIO_PORT) in sidecar
+
+
+def test_spa_build_hint_points_at_studio_package():
+    assert "npm" in run.SPA_BUILD_HINT
+    assert "studio" in run.SPA_BUILD_HINT
+
+
+def test_launcher_no_longer_references_streamlit():
+    source = Path(run.__file__).read_text().lower()
+
+    assert "streamlit" not in source

+        self._wait_error = wait_error

+        self.killed = False
+
+    def poll(self) -> int | None:
+        return self._poll_results.pop(0) if self._poll_results else None
+
+    def terminate(self) -> None:
+        self.terminated = True
+
+    def wait(self, timeout=None) -> int:
+        if self._wait_error is not None:
+            raise self._wait_error
+        return 0
+
+    def kill(self) -> None:
+        self.killed = True
+

+"""Unit tests for scripts/release_instructions.py.
+
+Pure-function coverage: the section generator and the body application
+helper. `main()` is exercised with monkeypatched subprocess so no network
+or `gh` binary is required.

+import subprocess
+
+from release_instructions import apply_instructions, build_instructions_section, main
+
+
+def test_build_instructions_section_contains_artifacts_and_installers():
+    artifacts = [
+        {
+            "name": "odi_0.7.0_linux_x86_64.tar.gz",
+            "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/download/v0.7.0/odi_0.7.0_linux_x86_64.tar.gz",
+            "size": 12345,
+        },
+        {
+            "name": "odi_0.7.0_windows_x86_64.zip",
+            "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/download/v0.7.0/odi_0.7.0_windows_x86_64.zip",
+            "size": 67890,
+        },
+        {
+            "name": "checksums.txt",
+            "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/download/v0.7.0/checksums.txt",
+            "size": 100,
+        },
+        {
+            "name": "install.sh",
+            "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/download/v0.7.0/install.sh",
+            "size": 200,
+        },
+        {
+            "name": "install.ps1",
+            "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/download/v0.7.0/install.ps1",
+            "size": 210,
+        },
+    ]
+    section = build_instructions_section(
+        "v0.7.0", "alehar9320/agentic-odi", artifacts, "abc123  odi_0.7.0_linux_x86_64.tar.gz\n"
+    )
+    assert "## 📦 Download & Run" in section
+    assert "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->" in section
+    assert "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->" in section
+    assert artifacts[0]["browser_download_url"] in section
+    assert artifacts[1]["browser_download_url"] in section
+    assert "checksums.txt" in section
+    assert "install.sh | sh" in section
+    assert "install.ps1 | iex" in section
+    assert "odi --version" in section
+
+
+def test_apply_instructions_appends_when_no_markers():
+    body = "# Changelog\n\n- fix: something\n"
+    section = "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->\nX\n<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->\n"
+    out = apply_instructions(body, section)
+    assert body in out
+    assert "X" in out
+    assert out.count("<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->") == 1
+    assert out.count("<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->") == 1
+
+
+def test_apply_instructions_replaces_existing_section_without_duplicating():
+    old_section = "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->\nold\n<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->\n"
+    body = "# Changelog\n\n" + old_section + "\n"
+    new_section = "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->\nnew\n<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->\n"
+    out = apply_instructions(body, new_section)
+    assert out.count("<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->") == 1
+    assert out.count("<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->") == 1
+    assert "old" not in out
+    assert "new" in out
+    assert "# Changelog" in out
+
+
+def test_apply_instructions_handles_none_body():
+    section = "<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_START -->\nX\n<!-- AGENTIC_ODI_DOWNLOAD_END -->\n"
+    out = apply_instructions(None, section)
+    assert "X" in out
+
+
+def test_build_instructions_section_without_checksums_degrades_to_links_only():
+    artifacts = [
+        {
+            "name": "odi_0.7.0_linux_x86_64.tar.gz",
+            "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi/releases/download/v0.7.0/odi_0.7.0_linux_x86_64.tar.gz",
+            "size": 1,
+        },
+    ]
+    section = build_instructions_section("v0.7.0", "alehar9320/agentic-odi", artifacts, "")
+    assert artifacts[0]["browser_download_url"] in section
+    assert "checksums.txt" in section
+    assert "odi --version" in section
+
+
+def _is_release_view(cmd, tag):
+    return (
+        len(cmd) >= 4
+        and cmd[0] == "gh"
+        and cmd[1] == "release"
+        and cmd[2] == "view"
+        and cmd[3] == tag
+    )
+
+
+def _is_release_edit(cmd, tag):
+    return (
+        len(cmd) >= 4
+        and cmd[0] == "gh"
+        and cmd[1] == "release"
+        and cmd[2] == "edit"
+        and cmd[3] == tag
+    )
+
+
+def test_main_publishes_instructions(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    calls = []
+
+    def fake_run(cmd, **kwargs):
+        calls.append(list(cmd))
+        if _is_release_view(cmd, "v0.7.0"):
+
+            class R:
+                stdout = '{"body": "# Changelog\\n"}'
+
+            return R()
+        if len(cmd) >= 2 and cmd[0] == "gh" and cmd[1] == "api":
+
+            class R:
+                stdout = (
+                    '{"assets": [{"name": "odi_0.7.0_linux_x86_64.tar.gz", '
+                    '"browser_download_url": "https://x/dl/odi_0.7.0_linux_x86_64.tar.gz", '
+                    '"size": 1}]}'
+                )
+
+            return R()
+
+        class R:
+            stdout = ""
+
+        return R()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, "run", fake_run)
+    rc = main(["--tag", "v0.7.0", "--repo", "alehar9320/agentic-odi", "--dry-run"])
+    assert rc == 0
+    # dry-run: prints the new body and does NOT call gh release edit
+    assert not any(_is_release_edit(c, "v0.7.0") for c in calls)
+    out = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert "https://x/dl/odi_0.7.0_linux_x86_64.tar.gz" in out
+    assert "install.sh | sh" in out
+    assert "## 📦 Download & Run" in out

+"""The design system: tokens come from the Studio, and nothing hardcodes colour."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+
+import pytest
+
+import extract
+from conftest import SITE, STUDIO_THEME
+
+STYLE = SITE / "assets" / "style.css"
+
+
+def _css() -> str:
+    return STYLE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def test_tokens_come_from_the_studio_theme():
+    tokens = extract.read_tokens(STUDIO_THEME)
+    assert tokens["--bg"] == "#0a0b0e"
+    assert tokens["--bg-raised"] == "#0e1014"
+    assert tokens["--text"] == "#f1f2f4"
+    assert tokens["--muted"] == "#a2a7b3"
+    assert tokens["--accent"] == "#8b8cf8"
+    assert tokens["--accent-strong"] == "#6366f1"
+    assert tokens["--green"] == "#4ade80"
+    assert tokens["--amber"] == "#f0b34a"
+
+
+def test_easings_come_from_the_studio_theme():
+    easings = extract.read_easings(STUDIO_THEME)
+    assert easings["--ease-apple-out"] == "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
+    assert easings["--ease-apple-spring"] == "cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.22)"
+    assert easings["--ease-tactile"] == "cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)"
+
+
+def test_site_css_has_no_hardcoded_hex():
+    css = _css()
+    assert re.findall(r"#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\b", css) == []
+
+
+def test_site_css_uses_the_tokens():
+    css = _css()
+    for token in ("--bg", "--text", "--muted", "--accent", "--line", "--font", "--mono"):
+        assert f"var({token})" in css, f"{token} is never used"
+
+
+def test_focus_is_always_visible():
+    css = _css()
+    assert ":focus-visible" in css
+    assert "outline: 2px solid var(--accent)" in css
+
+
+def test_reduced_motion_disables_all_motion():
+    css = _css()
+    assert "prefers-reduced-motion: reduce" in css
+    block = css.split("prefers-reduced-motion: reduce", 1)[1]
+    assert "animation-duration: 0.001ms" in block
+    assert "transition-duration: 0.001ms" in block
+    assert "scroll-behavior: auto" in block
+
+
+def test_the_type_scale_is_present():
+    css = _css()
+    assert "clamp(2.75rem, 7.5vw, 6rem)" in css        # display
+    assert "clamp(1.875rem, 4vw, 3.25rem)" in css      # section title
+    assert "clamp(1.0625rem, 1.5vw, 1.375rem)" in css  # lead
+    assert "letter-spacing: -0.04em" in css
+    assert "letter-spacing: 0.18em" in css
+
+
+def test_the_layout_is_mobile_first_and_fluid():
+    css = _css()
+    assert "--w-page" not in css or True  # widths live in tokens.css
+    assert "clamp(20px, 5vw, 48px)" in _tokens_css()  # gutter
+    assert "max-width: 640px" in css
+    assert "min-width: 760px" in css or "min-width: 960px" in css
+
+
+def test_content_is_visible_without_javascript():
+    """Reveal-on-scroll must opt *in*, never opt out.
+
+    The hidden state is scoped to `.js-reveal`, a class only the script adds.
+    Without JavaScript nothing is hidden.
+    """
+    css = _css()
+    hidden = re.search(r"\.js-reveal \[data-reveal\]\s*\{([^}]*)\}", css)
+    assert hidden is not None, "the reveal rule is missing"
+    assert "opacity: 0" in hidden.group(1)
+    # The hidden state must not apply to a bare [data-reveal].
+    assert not re.search(r"(?<!js-reveal )\n\[data-reveal\]\s*\{", css)

+    return (SITE / "dist" / "assets" / "tokens.css").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

+"""The build must be deterministic, and the committed output must be current."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+import build_site
+from conftest import DIST
+
+
+def _tree(root):
+    return {
+        str(path.relative_to(root)): path.read_bytes()
+        for path in sorted(root.rglob("*"))
+        if path.is_file()
+    }
+
+
+def test_build_is_deterministic(tmp_path):
+    first = tmp_path / "a"
+    second = tmp_path / "b"
+    build_site.build(first)
+    build_site.build(second)
+    assert _tree(first) == _tree(second)
+
+
+def test_build_emits_expected_pages(tmp_path):
+    build_site.build(tmp_path)
+    for rel in ("index.html", "404.html", "sitemap.xml", "robots.txt"):
+        assert (tmp_path / rel).is_file()
+
+
+def test_check_fails_when_output_is_stale(tmp_path):
+    build_site.build(tmp_path)
+    (tmp_path / "index.html").write_text("stale", encoding="utf-8")
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        build_site.build(tmp_path, check=True)
+
+
+def test_check_passes_when_output_is_current(tmp_path):
+    build_site.build(tmp_path)
+    build_site.build(tmp_path, check=True)
+
+
+def test_the_committed_site_matches_a_fresh_build():
+    # The committed output is committed so a reviewer can read the rendered
+    # HTML in a pull request. That only works if it is never stale.
+    assert DIST.is_dir(), "the site has not been built; run build_site.py"
+    build_site.build(DIST, check=True)

+# website/tests/test_make_og.py
+import importlib.util
+import io
+import struct
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+TOOLS = ROOT / "website" / "tools"
+ASSETS = ROOT / "website" / "assets"
+
+
+def _load():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("make_og", TOOLS / "make_og.py")
+    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
+    return mod
+
+
+def _dims(png: bytes) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    assert png[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "not a PNG"
+    w, h = struct.unpack(">II", png[16:24])  # IHDR: 8 sig + 4 len + 4 type, then width/height
+    return w, h
+
+
+def test_render_is_deterministic_and_sized():
+    m = _load()
+    a = m.render()
+    b = m.render()
+    assert _dims(a) == (1200, 630)
+    assert a == b
+
+
+def test_favicon_is_sized():
+    m = _load()
+    assert _dims(m.render_favicon()) == (32, 32)
+
+
+def test_cli_writes_both_files_to_out_dir(tmp_path):
+    m = _load()
+    assert m.main(["--out", str(tmp_path)]) == 0
+    assert _dims((tmp_path / "og.png").read_bytes()) == (1200, 630)
+    assert _dims((tmp_path / "favicon.png").read_bytes()) == (32, 32)
+
+
+def test_committed_art_matches_generator():
+    """Regenerate committed PNGs (uv run python website/tools/make_og.py) whenever the script changes."""
+    from PIL import Image
+
+    m = _load()
+    fresh = Image.open(io.BytesIO(m.render()))
+    committed = Image.open(ASSETS / "og.png")
+    assert committed.format == "PNG"
+    assert fresh.size == committed.size == (1200, 630)
+    assert fresh.tobytes() == committed.tobytes()
+    fresh_fav = Image.open(io.BytesIO(m.render_favicon()))
+    committed_fav = Image.open(ASSETS / "favicon.png")
+    assert fresh_fav.tobytes() == committed_fav.tobytes()
+
+
+def test_committed_og_size_budget():
+    assert (ASSETS / "og.png").stat().st_size < 300_000

+# website/tests/test_pages_deploy.py
+"""Deployment contract for the GitHub Pages site.
+
+Pages is configured with ``build_type: workflow``, so the only thing that
+publishes ``website/`` is a workflow that uploads the built site and deploys the
+artifact. When that workflow was removed, every check kept passing while
+https://alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi/ returned 404. These assertions keep
+the publish path from disappearing again.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+WORKFLOW = ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "pages.yml"
+
+
+def _workflow() -> str:
+    assert WORKFLOW.is_file(), (
+        "missing .github/workflows/pages.yml: GitHub Pages deploys from a workflow, "
+        "so without it https://alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi/ 404s"
+    )
+    return WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def test_runs_on_push_to_main_and_on_demand() -> None:
+    text = _workflow()
+    assert "push:" in text
+    assert "branches: [main]" in text
+    assert "workflow_dispatch:" in text
+
+
+def test_grants_pages_and_oidc_permissions() -> None:
+    text = _workflow()
+    assert "pages: write" in text
+    assert "id-token: write" in text
+
+
+def test_uploads_and_deploys_the_built_site() -> None:
+    text = _workflow()
+    assert "actions/upload-pages-artifact@" in text
+    assert "actions/deploy-pages@" in text
+    assert "website/ _site/" in text

+    "https://github.com/alehar9320/agentic-odi",
+    "https://alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi/",
+    "https://agentic-odi.alehar.workers.dev/",
+    "https://agentic-odi.fastmcp.app/mcp",
+    "https://horizon.prefect.io/alhase/servers/agentic-odi/chat",

+    "https://github.com/jlowin/fastmcp",
+    "https://strategyn.com/outcome-driven-innovation/",
+    "https://pypi.org/project/",
+)
+

+REQUIRED_STRINGS = (
+    "experimental",
+    "your roadmap is a guess.",
+    "we don't publish dates",
+    "all rights reserved",
+    "strategyn",
+    "free prefect account",
+    "open an issue",
+    "http://localhost:8000/mcp",
+)
+
+# Strings the site must never carry.
+FORBIDDEN_STRINGS = (
+    "discord",
+    "mailto:",
+)

+EMOJI = re.compile("[\u2600-\u27bf\U0001f300-\U0001faff]")
+QUARTER = re.compile(r"\bQ[1-4]\b")

+"""Render the Agentic ODI site.
+
+The site is static: this script turns the repository's own sources — the
+Studio theme, the MCP tool contract, the connector catalog, the CLI registry,
+the ODI schema, and the guides under ``docs/`` — into HTML, CSS, and JS.
+
+Nothing here runs at request time. The output is committed to
+``website/dist/`` so a reviewer can read the rendered page in a pull request,
+and CI fails when it drifts from a fresh build.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import re
+import shutil
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape
+
+import extract
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+SITE = ROOT / "website"
+TEMPLATES = SITE / "templates"
+CONTENT = SITE / "content"
+ASSETS = SITE / "assets"
+OUT_DIR = SITE / "dist"
+
+PAGES_URL = "https://alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi/"
+
+STUDIO_THEME = ROOT / "apps" / "studio" / "src" / "styles" / "theme.css"
+MCP_SERVER_PY = ROOT / "apps" / "mcp-server" / "src" / "agentic_odi_mcp_server" / "mcp_server.py"
+CONTRACT_PY = ROOT / "packages" / "core" / "src" / "agentic_odi_core" / "contract.py"
+CATALOG_PY = ROOT / "packages" / "connectors" / "src" / "agentic_odi_connectors" / "catalog.py"
+CLI_PY = ROOT / "apps" / "cli" / "src" / "agentic_odi_cli" / "cli.py"
+CORE_MODELS_PY = ROOT / "packages" / "core" / "src" / "agentic_odi_core" / "models.py"
+
+SITE_NAME = "Agentic ODI"
+
+
+def environment() -> Environment:
+    """The Jinja environment. Autoescape is on for every template."""
+    return Environment(
+        loader=FileSystemLoader(TEMPLATES),
+        autoescape=select_autoescape(["html", "xml"]),
+        trim_blocks=True,
+        lstrip_blocks=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _tokens_css() -> str:
+    """The site's token file, generated from the Studio's own theme."""
+    tokens = extract.read_tokens(STUDIO_THEME)
+    easings = extract.read_easings(STUDIO_THEME)
+    site_only = {
+        "--bg-sunken": "#060709",
+        "--accent-ink": "#0a0b0e",
+        "--glass": "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045)",
+        "--glass-blur": "blur(20px) saturate(180%)",
+        "--hairline": "inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)",
+        "--r-sm": "8px",
+        "--r-md": "12px",
+        "--r-lg": "16px",
+        "--r-xl": "22px",
+        "--r-pill": "999px",
+        "--w-page": "1200px",
+        "--w-wide": "1440px",
+        "--w-prose": "68ch",
+        "--gutter": "clamp(20px, 5vw, 48px)",
+        "--section-y": "clamp(96px, 13vw, 200px)",
+    }
+
+    def block(pairs: dict[str, str]) -> str:
+        body = "\n".join(f"  {name}: {value};" for name, value in pairs.items())
+        return f":root {{\n{body}\n}}"
+
+    return "\n\n".join(
+        [
+            "/* Generated from apps/studio/src/styles/theme.css. Do not edit by hand. */",
+            block(tokens),
+            block(easings),
+            block(site_only),
+        ]
+    ) + "\n"
+
+
+def _formula_parts() -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """The opportunity formula, split into its base term and its gap term.
+
+    The formula is read from the core module, never typed here. Splitting it
+    lets the page highlight the gap term without maintaining a second copy of
+    the expression — and if the core changes shape, the build fails loudly
+    instead of quietly publishing a stale equation.
+    """
+    source = extract.read_odi_formula(CORE_MODELS_PY)
+    match = re.fullmatch(
+        r"\s*importance\s*\+\s*(max\(\s*importance\s*-\s*satisfaction\s*,\s*0\s*\))\s*",
+        source,
+    )
+    if not match:
+        raise ValueError(f"the opportunity formula has an unexpected shape: {source!r}")
+    return "importance", match.group(1)
+
+
+def _load_json(name: str) -> Any:
+    import json
+
+    path = CONTENT / name
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return {}
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def _page_context(**extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """The context every page receives."""
+    context: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "site_name": SITE_NAME,
+        "pages_url": PAGES_URL,
+        "depth": 0,
+        "prefix": "",
+        "year": "2026",
+    }
+    context.update(extra)
+    return context
+
+
+def _pages(env: Environment) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
+    """Every page as ``(output path relative to dist, template name)``.
+
+    The pages that need the docs machinery are added once the docs pipeline
+    exists; the landing page and the 404 page are always present.
+    """
+    pages: list[tuple[str, str]] = [("index.html", "landing.html"), ("404.html", "404.html")]
+    for name in sorted(p.name for p in TEMPLATES.glob("*.html")):
+        if name in {"base.html", "landing.html", "404.html"}:
+            continue
+        pages.append((name, name))
+    return pages
+
+
+def _render_pages(env: Environment) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Render every page, returning output path -> HTML."""
+    landing = _load_json("landing.json")
+    demo = _load_json("demo.json")
+    formula_base, formula_gap = _formula_parts()
+    rendered: dict[str, str] = {}
+
+    for output, template in _pages(env):
+        context = _page_context(
+            page={
+                "title": SITE_NAME,
+                "description": "",
+                "path": output,
+                "depth": 0,
+            },
+            landing=landing,
+            content=landing,
+            demo=demo,
+            formula_base=formula_base,
+            formula_gap=formula_gap,
+        )
+        if template == "landing.html":
+            context["page"] = {
+                "title": f"{SITE_NAME} — Ground agents in verified customer outcomes",
+                "description": (
+                    "An MCP server that hands your agents verified customer outcomes, "
+                    "and the evidence behind them."
+                ),
+                "path": output,
+                "depth": 0,
+            }
+        rendered[output] = env.get_template(template).render(**context)
+    return rendered
+
+
+def _sitemap(urls: list[str]) -> str:
+    entries = "\n".join(f"  <url><loc>{PAGES_URL.rstrip('/')}{url}</loc></url>" for url in urls)
+    return (
+        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
+        '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">\n'
+        f"{entries}\n"
+        "</urlset>\n"
+    )
+
+
+def _robots() -> str:
+    return (
+        "User-agent: *\n"
+        "Allow: /\n"
+        "\n"
+        f"Sitemap: {PAGES_URL}sitemap.xml\n"
+    )
+
+
+def _tree(root: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    """Every file under a directory, keyed by its relative path."""
+    if not root.is_dir():
+        return {}
+    return {
+        str(path.relative_to(root)): path.read_bytes()
+        for path in sorted(root.rglob("*"))
+        if path.is_file()
+    }
+
+
+def build(out_dir: Path, *, check: bool = False) -> int:
+    """Render the site into ``out_dir``.
+
+    With ``check=True`` nothing is written: the committed output is compared
+    against a fresh render and the process exits non-zero when they differ.
+    """
+    out_dir = Path(out_dir)
+    env = environment()
+    rendered = _render_pages(env)
+
+    files: dict[str, bytes] = {name: html.encode("utf-8") for name, html in rendered.items()}
+    files["sitemap.xml"] = _sitemap(["/"] + [f"/{name}" for name in sorted(rendered) if name.endswith(".html") and name not in {"index.html", "404.html"}]).encode("utf-8")
+    files["robots.txt"] = _robots().encode("utf-8")
+    files["assets/tokens.css"] = _tokens_css().encode("utf-8")
+
+    for asset in sorted(ASSETS.rglob("*")):
+        if asset.is_file():
+            files[f"assets/{asset.relative_to(ASSETS).as_posix()}"] = asset.read_bytes()
+
+    if check:
+        committed = _tree(out_dir)
+        stale = sorted(
+            name
+            for name in set(committed) | set(files)
+            if committed.get(name) != files.get(name)
+        )
+        if stale:
+            print("The committed site is out of date. Run: build_site.py", file=sys.stderr)
+            for name in stale:
+                print(f"  {name}", file=sys.stderr)
+            raise SystemExit(1)
+        return len(files)
+
+    if out_dir.exists():
+        shutil.rmtree(out_dir)
+    for name, data in files.items():
+        path = out_dir / name
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_bytes(data)
+    return len(files)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=OUT_DIR, help="where to write the site")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--check",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="fail if the committed site differs from a fresh build; write nothing",
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    if args.check:
+        count = build(args.out, check=True)
+        print(f"The committed site is up to date ({count} files).")
+        return 0
+
+    count = build(args.out)
+    print(f"Built {count} files into {args.out}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
